### 1 — Scene
A cooked chicken meal with roasted potatoes, mixed cooked vegetables, mushrooms, broccoli/cauliflower, and leafy salad.

### 2 — Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using a circular approximation:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

### 3–7 — Items, coverage, volume, weight, and energy
The upper-left mixture appears to contain tomato, courgette/aubergine, and possibly onion. Exact ingredients are uncertain. The greens have a visible dressing sheen.

| Visible item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed cooked vegetables | 16% | 85 cm² × 2.2 cm = 187 ml | 0.65 | 121 | 70 | 85 |
| Roasted potato pieces | 11% | 58 cm² × 2 cm = 116 ml | 0.70 | 82 | 140 | 115 |
| Chicken drumstick, edible portion | 12% | 64 cm² × 1.8 cm = 115 ml | 0.95 | 109 | 200 | 218 |
| Cooked mushrooms | 7% | 37 cm² × 1.8 cm = 67 ml | 0.65 | 43 | 45 | 19 |
| Broccoli and pale cauliflower-like pieces | 12% | 64 cm² × 2 cm = 128 ml | 0.60 | 76 | 35 | 27 |
| Leafy greens with a few tomato pieces | 19% | 101 cm² × 2.4 cm = 242 ml | 0.15 | 36 | 20 | 7 |
| Oil-based dressing on greens | Overlay¹ | Approximately 5.5 ml | 0.91 | 5 | 884 | 44 |

¹Dressing overlaps the greens, so it adds no separate footprint. Cooking fat in the roasted foods is included in their energy densities.

### 8 — Sanity check
Coverage totals **77%**, consistent with the visible food and exposed plate margins. The leafy pile contributes relatively little weight, while the chicken and cooked vegetables supply most of it.

**Estimated edible weight: 472 g. Estimated energy: 515 kcal.** Chicken bone is excluded. A reasonable uncertainty range is approximately **400–570 g and 400–650 kcal**.
